label: IGH / BCL10
tumor_contexts: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of MALT

sections.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus, with potent B-lineage regulatory elements.
BCL10 encodes a signaling adaptor in the CARD11-BCL10-MALT1 NF-kappaB pathway.
The t(1;14) increases BCL10 expression and promotes signaling through the BCL10-MALT1/NF-kappaB pathway. It is a recurrent regulatory rearrangement in MALT lymphoma.
